title: Actually Forgotten Additions
description: Adds several features not present in modern versions of Actually Additions!
body:
## Disclaimer: I am not affiliated with Elipeck or any other developers. I am simply someone making an addon for removed/unused/unimplemented features. 

Adds several features that aren't in modern Actually Additions.

 

-Black Lotus makes an appearence, spawning rarely in the Overworld and End

-The Fishing Net is back, place it above water to catch fish and treasures!

-The Block of Ender Pearl is back, purely because it looked cool

-The Powered Furnace is back, smelt two items at the same time with this cool block!

-The beloved Smiley Cloud is back, name it, and watch it stare endlessly into your soul.

-Storage Crates are back (yay...) may be a bit buggy, so beware. 

 

## Credits:
Assets belong to Elipeck and his team of developers. I do not own any of the assets. just the code. 

if you're an original author and wish for the mod to be taken down, dm me on discord at phwee and I'll take care of your request.
